title: Cambridge IELTS 12 Test 8 Writing Task 2
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
prompt: Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
scenario: Some people believe that allowing children to make their own choices on everyday matters (such as food, clothes and entertainment) is likely to result in a society of individuals who only think about their own wishes. Other people believe that it is important for children to make decisions about matters that affect them.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
